participant_id.Description: Unique participant identifier (as in the source release)

age.Description: Age of the participant at time of testing (source participants.tsv)

sex.Description: Biological sex of the participant (source participants.tsv)

handedness.Description: Handedness (source column 'hand'; not reported for any participant)

n_contacts_implanted.Description: Number of implanted sEEG contacts (Verwoert et al. 2022, Table 1)

n_contacts_recorded.Description: Number of recorded contacts, excluding the reference contact (Verwoert et al. 2022, Table 1)

native_language.Description: All participants were native speakers of Dutch (Verwoert et al. 2022, Methods)

pathology.Description: Clinical indication for the sEEG implantation (Verwoert et al. 2022, Methods)
